name: ANSI/IEEE single-phase ac motor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for single-phase ac motor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The single-phase AC motor form identifies a documented electrical load with a specified single-phase supply. Winding terminals, start/run components and mechanical driven duty require the actual motor data beyond the simplified machine circle.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Locate the selected motor connection diagram before wiring auxiliary components.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A single-phase motor form does not select a universal capacitor or starting arrangement.
